title: The Expires field must be a parseable date

spec.name: RFC 9116
spec.normative_quote: The value of this field is formatted according to the Internet profiles of [ISO.8601-1] and [ISO.8601-2] as defined in [RFC3339].
spec.note: Verified against a live fetch of https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9116.txt on 2026-07-30. Corrects a prior defect: the quote cited RFC 5322 (a generic email/field-grammar RFC referenced elsewhere in §2.2) and inverted the RFC's own MUST/RECOMMENDED framing -- the real §2.5.5 text places no MUST on the date format at all; RFC3339/ISO 8601 formatting is simply stated as how the field's value is formatted, with no normative strength attached to that clause.

applicability: A security.txt body containing an Expires: field whose value does not parse as a date.

cases.name: Expires value is not a date
Expires value parses cleanly -- this rule does not fire
